\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

⇒ (a + c) = 34 × 2 = 68

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

c की आयु = 36 वर्ष

\n\n

उत्तर 36 वर्ष है।

సగటు

"solution_html": {"en": "

Given:

\n\n

3x-1 + 3x+1 = 2430

\n\n

Calculations:

\n\n

3x-1 + 3x+1 = 2430

\n\n

3x × \\(\\dfrac{1}{3}\\) + 3x × 3 = 2430

\n\n

3x × (\\(\\dfrac{1}{3}\\) + 3) = 2430

\n\n

3x × \\(\\dfrac{10}{3}\\) = 2430

\n\n

3x = 2430 × \\(\\dfrac{3}{10}\\)

\n\n

3x = 243 × 3

\n\n

3x = 35 × 31

\n\n

3x = 35+1

\n\n

3x = 36

\n\n

x = 6

\n\n

∴ The answer is 6.

Formula:

\n\n

V = B × h, where 

\n\n

V = Volume of prism

\n\n

B = Base area of prism

\n\n

h = height of prism

\n\n

TSA = P × h + 2 × B, where

\n\n

P = Perimeter of the base

\n\n

Concept:

\n\n

A regular hexagon is formed of six equilateral triangles of the side same as the side of the hexagon. Hence, area of regular hexagon with side "a" is equal to the 6 times the area of the equilateral triangle with side "a".

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Let the side of the hexagon be "a"

\n\n

B = 6 × \\(√3\\over4\\) × a2

\n\n

P = 6 × a

\n\n

Substituting the values in the formula for TSA-

\n\n

⇒ 192√3 = 6a × 6√3 + 2 × 6 × \\(√3\\over4\\) × a2

\n\n

Solving the equation, we get-

\n\n

⇒ a2 + 12a - 64 = 0

\n\n

⇒ a2 + 16a - 4a - 64 = 0

\n\n

⇒ a(a + 16) - 4(a + 16) = 0

\n\n

⇒ (a - 4)(a + 16) = 0

\n\n

⇒ a = 4 or -16 (-16 is not applicable since the dimensions cannot be negative)

\n\n

∴ a = 4 cm.

\n\n

Volume of the prism = 6 × \\(√3\\over4\\) × 4 × 4 ×  6√3 = 432 cm3.

\n\n

The volume of the prism is 432 cm3.

Given:

\n\n

The HCF of two numbers A and B = 25

\n\n

The HCF of two other numbers C and D = 32

\n\n

Concept used:

\n\n

HCF -  The product of lowest powers of the common factor

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

The HCF of two numbers A and B = 25

\n\n

⇒ (5 × 5 × 1)

\n\n

The HCF of two other numbers C and D = 32

\n\n

⇒ (2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 1)

\n\n

Now,

\n\n

The HCF of (A, B) and (C, D) = HCF of 25 and 32 

\n\n

⇒ 1

\n\n

∴ The HCF of A, B, C and D is 1.

Given:

\n\n

AB = 12, BC = 18, AC = a and OX = (√23)/(√2).

\n\n

Concept used:

\n\n

Apollonius theorem:

\n\n

For a Δ ABC, where AX is the median of side BC, then

\n\n

AB2 + AC2 = 2(AX2 + BX2)

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

\n\n

As AX is the median

\n\n

So, AX = 3 × OX = 3 × \\(\\sqrt{23\\over2}\\)

\n\n

Now, using Apollonius theorem:

\n\n

AB2+ AC2 = 2(AX2 + BX2)

\n\n

⇒ 122 + a2 = 2 [(3 × \\(\\sqrt{23\\over2}\\))2 + 92]

\n\n

⇒ 144 + a2 = 2 [9 × 23/2 + 81]

\n\n

⇒ 144 + a2 = 2 × 9 × 23/2 + 2 × 81

\n\n

⇒ 144 + a2 = 207 + 162

\n\n

⇒ a2 = 369 - 144 = 225

\n\n

⇒ a = 15 cm

\n\n

∴​ The correct answer is option (4).

Given:

\n\n

The greatest number on dividing 342 and 480 leaves the remainder 6 and 4 respectively.

\n\n

Concept used:

\n\n

HCF is the largest number or quantity that is a factor of each member of a group of numbers.

\n\n

Calculation:&", "hn": "\n

दिया गया है:

\n\n

वह अधिकतम संख्या जिससे 342 और 480 को विभाजित करने पर क्रमशः 6 और 4 शेषफल प्राप्त होता है।

\n\n

प्रयुक्त अवधारणा:

\n\n

महत्तम समापवर्तक, वह अधिकतम संख्या या राशि है, जो संख्याओं के समूह के प्रत्येक सदस्य का एक गुणनखंड है।

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

वह अधिकतम संख्या जिससे 342 और 480 को विभाजित करने पर क्रमशः 6 और 4 शेषफल प्राप्त होता है। (342 - 6) अर्थात 336 और (480 - 4) अर्थात 476 का महत्तम समापवर्तक है", "te": "

ఇచ్చిన:

\n\n

342 మరియు 480ని భాగిస్తే, వరుసగా 6 మరియు 4 శేషాలను వదిలే పెద్ద సంఖ్య

\n\n

ఉపయోగించిన భావన:

\n\n

గ.సా.భా అనేది సంఖ్యల సమూహంలోని ప్రతి సభ్యునికి కారణాంకంగా ఉండే అతిపెద్ద సంఖ్య లేదా పరిమాణం.

\n\n

లెక్కింపు:

\n\n

342 మరియు 480ని భాగిస్తే, వరుసగా 6 మరియు 4 శేషాలను వదిలే పెద్ద సంఖ్య. (342 - 6) యొక్క గ.సా.భా అంటే, 336 మరియు (480 - 4) అంటే, 476.

\n\n

336 = 28 × 12

\n\n

476 = 28 × 17

\n\n

గ.సా.భా ( 333 , 476 ) = 28

\n\n

∴ ఎంపిక 4 సరైన సమాధానం.

\n\n

\n\n

વપરાયેલ ખ્યાલ:

\n\n

ગુ.સા.અ એ સૌથી મોટી સંખ્યા અથવા જથ્થો છે જે સંખ્યાઓના જૂથના દરેક સભ્યનું પરિબળ છે.

\n\n

ગણતરી:

\n\n

342 અને 480 ને ", "mr": "

दिलेल्याप्रमाणे:

\n\n

342 आणि 480 ला विभाजित केल्यावर अनुक्रमे 6 आणि 4 बाकी उरते ती सर्वात मोठी संख्या.

\n\n

वापरलेली संकल्पना:

\n\n

मसावि ही सर्वात मोठी संख्या किंवा संख्या आहे जी संख्यांच्या गटातील प्रत्येक सदस्याचा घटक आहे.

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

342 आणि 480 ला विभाजित केल्यावर अनुक्रमे 6 आणि 4 बाकी उरते ती सर्वात मोठी संख्या ही (342 - 6) म्हणजेच 336 आणि (480 - 4) म्हणजेच 476 यांचा मसावि आहे.

\n\n

336 = 28 × 12

\n\n

476 = 28 × 17

\n\n

मसावि (333, 476) = 28

\n\n

∴ पर्याय 4 हे योग्य उत्तर आहे.

\n\n

একটি বৃহত্তম সংখ্যা দ্বারা 342 এবং 480 কে ভাগ করলে, যথাক্রমে 6 এবং 4 ভাগশেষ থাকে।

\n\n

C வணிகத்தில் சேர்ந்த நேரத்தைக் கண்டறியவும்.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "4"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "8"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "6"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "7"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

    Concept: 

    \n\n

    In a business, the profits are shared in the ratio of the product of the sum and the time for which the sum is invested for each of the partners. Hence, the product of Investment (I) and time (T) is always in proportion to the profits obtained (P). 

    \n\n

    ⇒ P = I × T 

    \n\n

    Calculation:

    \n\n

    Total investment by A at the end of the year = Rs 3000 × 12 = Rs 36,000

    \n\n

    Total investment by B at the end of the year = Rs 5000 × 12 = Rs 60,000

    \n\n

    Let C invest in time "t" 

    \n\n

    Total investment by C at the end of the year= Rs 8000 × t = 8000t

    \n\n

    ⇒ Ratio of investment or profit = 36 : 60 : 8t or 9 : 15 : 2t

    \n\n

    ⇒ \\(2t\\over9+15+2t\\) = \\(250\\over1000\\)

    \n\n

    ⇒ 8t = 24 + 2t

    \n\n

    ∴ 6t = 24 or t = 4 months

    \n\n

    ⇒ Time after which C joined the business = 12 - 4 = 8 months.

    \n\n

    C joined after 8 months.

    \n\n

    Alternate MethodRatio of profit of C to the profit of A and B = 250 : 750 = 1 : 3

    \n\n

    Ratio of investment of C to the total investment of A and B combined = 8000 : (3000 + 5000) = 1 : 1

    \n\n

    \n\n

    3 units = 12 months.

    \n\n

    ∴ 1 unit = 4 months or C has invested for 4 months.

    \n\n

    Time after which C joined the business = 12 - 4 = 8 months.

    अवधारणा: 

    \n\n

    एक व्यवसाय में, लाभ को धनराशि और वह समय जिसके लिए प्रत्येक भागीदार द्वारा धनराशि का निवेश किया जाता है, के गुणनफल के अनुपात में साझा किया जाता है। इसलिए, निवेश (I) और समय (T) का गुणनफल हमेशा अर्जित लाभ (P) के समानुपात में होता है।

    \n\n

    ⇒ P = I × T 

    \n\n

    गणना:

    \n\n

    वर्ष के अंत में A द्वारा कुल निवेश = 3000 रुपये × 12 = 36,000 रुपये

    \n\n

    वर्ष के अंत में B द्वारा कुल निवेश = 5000 रुपये × 12 = 60,000 रुपये

    \n\n

    माना, C समय "t" के लिए निवेश करता है

    \n\n

    वर्ष के अंत में C द्वारा कुल निवेश భావన: 

    \n\n

    వ్యాపారంలో, లాభాలు అనేవి ప్రతి భాగస్వామి మొత్తాన్ని పెట్టుబడి పెట్టే సమయంతో మొత్తం యొక్క లబ్దం యొక్క నిష్పత్తిలో పంచబడుతుంది. అందువల్ల, పెట్టుబడి (I) మరియు కాలం (T) ల లబ్దం అనేవి ఎల్లప్పుడూ పొందిన లాభాలకు (P) నిష్పత్తిలో ఉంటుంది.

    \n\n

    ⇒ P = I × T 

    \n\n

    గణన:

    \n\n

    సంవత్సరం చివరిలో A ద్వారా మొత్తం పెట్టుబడి = రూ 3000 × 12 = రూ 36,000

    \n\n

    సంవత్సరం చివరిలో B ద్వారా మొత్తం పెట్టుబడి = రూ 5000 × 12 = రూ 60,000

    \n\n

    C, కాలంలో \"t\"లో పెట్టుబడి పెట్టనివ్వండి

    \n\n

    సంవత్సరం చివరిలో C ద్వారా మొత్తం పెట్టుబడి= రూ 8000 × 12 = 8000t

    \n\n

    ⇒ పెట్టుబడి లేదా లాభం నిష్పత్తి = 36 : 60 : 8t లేదా 9 : 15 : 2 టి

    \n\n

    ⇒ \\(2t\\over9+15+2t\\) = \\(250\\over1000\\)

    \n\n

    ⇒ 8t = 24 + 2t

    \n\n

"correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

    Given:

    \n\n

    The age of a father is determined by adding the ages of his five children.

    \n\n

    After 15 years, the children's combined ages will be twice as old as the father.

    \n\n

    Calculation:

    \n\n

    Let, the father's age is x years.

    \n\n

    And the sum of the ages of his 5 children is y years.

    \n\n

    Now,

    \n\n

    After 15 years,

    \n\n

    Age of father = (x + 15) years.

    \n\n

    Sum of ages of 5 children =  (y + 5 × 15) years  = (y + 75) years

    \n\n

    According to the question,

    \n\n

    When all of the children's ages add up to the father's age, x = y

    \n\n

    ⇒ 2(x + 15) = (y + 75)

    \n\n

    ⇒ 2x + 30 = y + 75

    \n\n

    ⇒ 2x = y + 75 - 30

    \n\n

    ⇒ 2x = y + 45

    \n\n

    We know that,

    \n\n

    x = y

    \n\n

    So, We can put x in the place of y.

    \n\n

    ⇒ 2x = x + 45

    \n\n

    ⇒ 2x - x = 45

    \n\n

    ⇒ x = 45 years

    \n\n

    ∴ The father is a 45-year-old man.

    ", "hn": "\n

    दिया गया:

    \n\n

    एक पिता की आयु उसके पांच बच्चों की आयु को जोड़कर निर्धारित की जाती है।

    \n\n

    15 वर्ष बाद, बच्चों की संयुक्त आयु, पिता की आयु की दोगुनी होगी।

    \n\n

    गणना:

    \n\n

    माना, पिता की आयु x वर्ष है।

    \n\n

    और उसके 5 बच्चों की आयु का योग y वर्ष है।

    \n\n

    अब,

    \n\n

    15 वर्ष बाद,

    \n\n

    पिता की आयु = (x + 15) वर्ष 

    \n\n

    5 बच्चों की आयु का योग = (y + 5 × 15) वर्ष = (y + 75) वर्ष

    \n\n

    प्रश्नानुसार,

    \n\n

    जब सभी बच्चों की आयु, पिता की आयु में जुड़ जाती है, तो x = y

    \n\n

    ⇒ 2(x + 15) = (y + 75)

    \n\n

    ⇒ 2x + 30 = y + 75

    \n\n

    ⇒ 2x = y + 75 - 30

    \n\n

    ⇒ 2x = y + 45

    \n\n

    हम जानते हैं कि,

    \n\n

    x = y

    \n\n

    इसलिए, हम y के स्थान पर x रख सकते हैं।

    \n\n

    ⇒ 2x = x + 45

    \n\n

    ⇒ 2x - x = 45

    \n\n

    ⇒ x = 45 वर्ष

    \n\n

    ∴ पिता 45 वर्षीय व्यक्ति है।

    ఇచ్చినది:

    \n\n

    ఐదుగురు పిల్లల వయస్సును కలపడం ద్వారా తండ్రి వయస్సు నిర్ణయించబడుతుంది.

    \n\n

    15 సంవత్సరాల తర్వాత, పిల్లల ఉమ్మడి వయస్సు తండ్రి కంటే రెండింతలు ఉంటుంది.

    \n\n

    గణన:

    \n\n

    తండ్రి వయస్సు x సంవత్సరాలు 

    \n\n

    మరియు అతని 5 మంది పిల్లల వయస్సుల మొత్తం y సంవత్సరాలు అనుకుందాం.

    \n\n

    ఇప్పుడు,

    \n\n

    15 సంవత్సరాల తర్వాత,

    \n\n

    \n\n

    ஒரு தந்தையின் வயது அவரது ஐந்து குழந்தைகளின் வயதைக் கூட்டுவதன் மூலம் தீர்மானிக்கப்படுகிறது.

    \n\n

    15 ஆண்டுகளுக\n்குப் பிறகு, குழந்தைகளின் வயதின் கூட்டுத்தொகையானது தந்தையின் வயதைப் போல இரண்டு மடங்கு அதிகமாக இருக்கும்.

    \n\n

    கணக்கீடு:

    \n\n

    தந்தையின் வயதை x வயது எனக்கொள்க.

    \n\n

    அவரது 5 குழந்தைகளின் வயதின் கூட்டுத்தொகையை y வயது எனக்கொள்க. 

    \n\n

    இப்போது,

    \n\n

    15 ஆண்டுகளுக்குப் பிறகு,

    \n\n

    தந்தையின் வயது = (x + 15)  

    \n\n

    5 குழந்தைகளின் வயதின் கூட்டுத்தொகை =  (y + 5 × 15) years  = (y + 75) 

    \n\n

    கேள்வியின்படி நாம் பெறுவது,

    \n\n

    அனைத்து குழந்தைகளின் வயதையும் தந்தையின் வயதையும் கூட்டினால், x = y

    \n\n

    ⇒ 2(x + 15) = (y + 75)

    \n\n

    ⇒ 2x + 30 = y + 75

    \n\n

    ⇒ 2x = y + 75 - 30

    \n\n

    ⇒ 2x = y + 45

    \n\n

    நாம் அறிந்தது,

    \n\n

    x = y

    \n\n

    எனவே, y உள்ள இடத்தில் x எனப் பிரதியிட,

    \n\n

    ⇒ 2x = x + 45

    \n\n

    ⇒ 2x - x = 45

    \n\n

    ⇒ x = 45 years

    Given:

    \n\n

    Time = 11 months

    \n\n

    Interest = 0.08 times the principal amount

    \n\n

    Concept used:

    \n\n

    Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

    \n\n

    Amount = P + SI

    \n\n

    where

    \n\n

    P = Principal amount

    \n\n

    R = Rate of interest per year

    \n\n

    T = Time in years

    \n\n

    Calculation:दिया गया है:

    \n\n

    समय = 11 महीने

    \n\n

    ब्याज = मूल राशि का 0.08 गुना

    \n\n

    प्रयुक्त अवधारणा:

    \n\n

    साधारण ब्याज, SI = (P × R × T)/100

    \n\n

    मिश्रधन = P + SI

    \n\n

    जहां 

    \n\n

    P = मूलधन राशि

    \n\n

    R = प्रति वर्ष ब्याज की दर

    \n\n

    T = वर्षों में समय

    \n\n

    गणना:

    \n\n

    माना ब्याज की दर और मूलधन क्रमशः R% और P है।

    \n\n

    11 महीने = 11/12 वर्ष

    \n\n

    अवधारणा के अनुसार,

    \n\n

    (P × R × 11/12)/100 = 0.08 × P

    \n\n

    ⇒ (P × R × 11/12) = 8P

    \n\n

    ⇒ R × 11/12 = 8

    \n\n

    ⇒ R = (8 × 12)/11

    \n\n

    ⇒ R ≈ 8.7

    \n\n

    ∴ ब्याज दर 8.7% है।

Select the odd one out from the given alternatives.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "(113, 109, 105)"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "(142, 137, 133)"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "(197, 193, 189)"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "(162, 158, 154)"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "निम्नलिखित प्रश्न में, तीन संख्याओं के चार समूह दिए गये हैं। प्रत्येक समूह में दूसरी और तीसरी संख्या पहली संख्या से किसी निश्चित तर्क/नियम/सम्बन्ध से सबंधित हैं। तीन संख्याएं निश्चित तर्क/नियम/सम्बन्ध से समान हैं। दिए गये विकल्पों में से बेजोड़ विकल्प का चयन कीजिये।", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "(113, 109, 105)"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "(142, 137, 133)"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "(197, 193, 189)"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "(162, 158, 154)"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

    The logic followed here is:-

    \n\n

    First number - 4 → Second number

    \n\n

    First number - 8 → Third number

    \n\n

    1) In 113, 109, 105

    \n\n

    113 - 4 = 109

    \n\n

    113 - 8 = 105

    \n\n

    2) In (142, 137, 133)

    \n\n

    142 - 4 = 138 not 137

    \n\n

    142 - 8 = 134 not 133

    \n\n

    3) (197, 193, 189)

    \n\n

    197 - 4 = 193

    \n\n

    197 - 8 = 189

    \n\n

    4) (162, 158, 154)

    \n\n

    162 - 4 = 158

    \n\n

    162 - 8 = 154

    \n\n

    As can be seen clearly from above that the group i.e. (142, 137, 133) is the odd one out as it doesn't follow the logic.

    \n\n

    Hence, the correct answer is "(142, 137, 133)".

    ", "hn": "

    \n\n

    \n\n

    पहली संख्या - 8 → तीसरी संख्या

    \n\n

    1) 113, 109, 105 में

    \n\n

    113 - 4 = 109

    The logic followed here is:

    \n\n

    Rank of Karishma from the left end = 16th

    \n\n

    Rank of Karishma from the right end = 18th

    \n\n

    Total number of student in the row = Rank of Karishma from the left end + Rank of Karishma from the right end - 1.

    \n\n

    = 16 + 18 - 1 

    \n\n

    = 34 - 1

    \n\n

    = 33.

    \n\n

    Hence, the correct answer is 'Option 3'.

    \n", "hn": "

    यहाँ अनुसरित तर्क निम्न है:

    \n\n

    बाएँ छोर से करिश्मा का स्थान = 16वाँ

    \n\n

    दाएँ छोर से करिश्मा का स्थान = 18वाँ

    \n\n

    पंक्ति में विद्यार्थियों की कुल संख्या = बाएँ छोर से करिश्मा का स्थान + दाएँ छोर से करिश्मा का स्थान - 1

    \n\n

    = 16 + 18 - 1

    \n\n

    = 34 - 1

    \n\n

    = 33

    \n\n

    अतः सही उत्तर 'विकल्प 3' है।

    \n\n

    All devotion, zeal, and fury are strong emotions.

    \n\n

    Whereas, 

    \n\n

    Vision is not an emotion.

    \n\n

    Hence, vision is the odd one.

    \n\n

    Important PointsDevotion → love, loyalty, or enthusiasm for a person or activity.

    \n\n

    Zeal → great energy or enthusiasm in pursuit of a cause or an objective.

    \n\n

    Vision → the ability to think about or plan the future with imagination or wisdom.

    \n\n

    Fury → extreme strength or violence in an action or a natural phenomenon.

    सभी भक्ति, जोश और रोष प्रबल भावनाएँ हैं।

    \n\n

    Important Points

    \n\n

    भक्ति → किसी व्यक्ति या गतिविधि के लिए प्यार, वफादारी या उत्साह।

    \n\n

    जोश → किसी कारण या उद्देश्य की खोज में महान ऊर्जा या उत्साह।

    \n\n

    दृष्टि → कल्पना या ज्ञान के साथ भविष्य के बारे में सोचने या योजना बनाने की क्षमता।

    \n\n

    रोष → किसी क्रिया या प्राकृतिक घटना में अत्यधिक शक्ति या हिंसा।

    దృష్టి అనేది భావోద్వేగం కాదు.

    ముఖ్యమైన పాయింట్లు భక్తి → ఒక వ్యక్తి లేదా కార్యాచరణ పట్ల ప్రేమ, విధేయత లేదా ఉత్సాహం.

    \n\n

    सर्व भक्ती, आवेश आणि राग या तीव्र भावना आहेत.

    \n\n

    तर,

    \n\n

    दृष्टी ही भावना नाही.

    \n\n

    म्हणून, दृष्टी ही विषम आहे.

    \n\n

    Important Points

    \n\n

    भक्ती → प्रेम, निष्ठा किंवा एखाद्या व्यक्तीबद्दल किंवा क्रियाकलापांबद्दलचा उत्साह.

    \n\n

    आवेश → एखाद्या कारणाचा किंवा उद्देशाचा पाठपुरावा करण्यासाठी मोठी ऊर्जा किंवा उत्साह.

    \n\n

    दृष्टी → कल्पनाशक्ती किंवा शहाणपणाने भविष्याबद्दल विचार करण्याची किंवा योजना करण्याची क्षमता.

    \n\n

    राग → एखाद्या क्रियेत किंवा नैसर्गिक घटनेत अत्यंत ताकद किंवा हिंसा.

    Given :

    \n\n
      \n\t
    1. Seven people - A, B, C, D, E, F and G.
      2. \n\t
    2. All of them are sitting in a straight row.
      3. \n\t
    3. All of them are facing north direction. 
      4. \n
    \n\n

    Explanation :

    \n\n

    1) A sits third to the left of D.

    \n\n

    2) D sits to the extreme right.

    \n\n

    3) Only two people sit between A and F.

    \n\n

    \n\n

    4) B is an immediate neighbour of F.

    \n\n

    5) Only 1 person sits between C and D.

    \n\n

    6) G is not an immediate neighbour of A.

    \n\n

    After positioning B, C and G only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e E.

    \n\n

    \n\n

    Thus, according to the final arrangement three people sit between F and C i.e B, E and A.

    \n\n

    Hence, "3" is the correct answer.

    दिया गया है:

    \n\n
      \n\t
    1. सात व्यक्ति - A, B, C, D, E, F और G
      2. \n\t
    2. वे सभी एक सीधी पंक्ति में बैठे हैं।
      3. \n\t
    3. उन सभी का मुख उत्तर दिशा की ओर है।
      4. \n
    \n\n

    व्याख्या :

    \n\n

    1) A, D के बाईं ओर तीसरे स्थान पर बैठा है।

    \n\n

    2) D सबसे दाईं ओर बैठा है।

    \n\n

    3) A और F के बीच केवल दो व्यक्ति बैठे हैं।

    \n\n

    \n\n

    4) B, F का निकटतम पड़ोसी है।

    \n\n

    5) C और D के बीच केवल 1 व्यक्ति बैठा है।

    \n\n

    6) G, A का निकटतम पड़ोसी नहीं है।

    \n\n

    B, C और G को स्थान देने के बाद केवल एक स्थान शेष बचता है जिस पर एकमात्र व्यक्ति अर्थात E बैठेगा।

    \n\n

    \n\n

    \n\n

    B, C మరియు G స్థానాలను ఉంచిన తర్వాత ఒక స్థానం మాత్రమే మిగిలి ఉంటుంది, అది మిగిలి ఉన్న ఏకైక వ్యక్తి అంటే E.

    \n\n

    \n\n

    \n\n

font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; vertical-align: baseline; text-wrap: wrap;">They said to her, &quot;We were planning a surprise party for our friend, would you like to help?&quot;</span></span></p>\n"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

    The correct answer is 'They said to her, "We are planning a surprise party for our friend, would you like to help?"'

    \n\n


    \nKey Points

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • The sentence in the Indirect Speech is in Past Continuous tense (were planning) and future in the past tense (would like).
      • \n\t
    • Therefore, when converting to Direct Speech, the sentence should be in Present Continuous tense (are planning) and will future/or a polite request (would you like) as per the original context. This aligns with the rule in English grammar that states we should convert the verbs forward one step in time in direct speech.
      • \n\t
    • Hence, "they were planning" becomes "we are planning" and "would she like" converts to "would you like" in the Direct Speech.
      • \n
    \n\n

    Therefore, the correct answer is- 'Option 1'

    \n\n

     Additional Information

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • The problem with option 2 is that "we plan" is in the present simple tense which doesn't match the past continuous tense used in the indirect speech version of the sentence.
      • \n\t
    • The problem with Option 3 is that "we have been planning" is in the present perfect continuous tense, which does not match the past continuous tense in the indirect speech. Also, the request "will you help?" doesn't keep the original politeness ("would you like to help?").
      • \n\t
    • The problem with Option 4 is that "we were planning" remains in the past continuous tense which is inappropriate because it does not adhere to the principle of moving verbs forward one step in time when making a conversion to direct speech.
      • \n

    \n\n

    This grandiose plan for rural transformation faltered with its first steps.

    \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "absurdly exaggerated"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "monumental"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "insignificant"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "majestic"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

    The correct answer is "insignificant."

    \n\n

    Key Points

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • Grandiose means overly grand or elaborate in design or description, often to the point of being unrealistic or pretentious. It can also refer to a feeling of self-importance or grandeur. (भव्यता का अर्थ डिजाइन या विवरण में अत्यधिक भव्य या विस्तृत होता है, जो अक्सर अवास्तविक या दिखावटी होने की स्थिति में होता है। यह आत्म-महत्व या भव्यता की भावना का भी उल्लेख कर सकता है।) \n\n\t
        \n\t\t
      • Example: The CEO's grandiose plans for the company were met with skepticism by the board of directors.
        • \n\t
      \n\t
      • \n
    \n\n

    Let's see the meanings of the given words.

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • Absurdly exaggerated - This means that the plan was overly exaggerated and unrealistic.(इसका मतलब है कि योजना अत्यधिक अतिरंजित और अवास्तविक थी।) \n\n\t
        \n\t\t
      • Example: The grandiose plans for a flying car were deemed absurdly exaggerated by experts in the field.
        • \n\t
      \n\t
      • \n\t
    • Monumental - This means that the plan was very large and important. (इसका मतलब यह है कि योजना बहुत बड़ी और महत्वपूर्ण थी।)\n\t
        \n\t\t
      • Example: The construction of the Great Wall of China was a monumental achievement.
        • \n\t
      \n\t
      • \n\t
    • Insignificant - This means that the plan was unimportant and not worth noticing. (इसका मतलब है कि योजना महत्वहीन थी और ध्यान देने योग्य नहीं थी।) \n\t
        \n\t\t
      • Example: The grandiose plans for a new playground were deemed insignificant by the school board.
        • \n\t
      \n\t
      • \n\t
    • Majestic - This means that the plan was grand and impressive. (इसका मतलब है कि योजना भव्य और प्रभावशाली थी।)\n\t
        \n\t\t
      • Example: The grandiose plans for a new palace were deemed majestic by the king.
        • \n\t
      \n\t

    The correct answer is "Modesty"

    \n\n

    Key Points

    \n\n

    \n\n
      \n\t

(उत्साह किसी चीज में उत्साह और रुचि की प्रबल भावना को दर्शाता है। इसका तात्पर्य किसी विशेष गतिविधि, विचार या कारण के लिए उत्सुक, भावुक या समर्पित होने की स्थिति से है।)\n\n\t
        \n\t\t

        • \n\t
      \n\t
      • \n\t
    • Laziness refers to a disinclination to exert oneself; idleness, it implies a state of being unwilling or unable to work, to be active or to make an effort. (आलस्य का अर्थ है परिश्रम करने की अनिच्छा; आलस्य, इसका तात्पर्य अनिच्छुक या काम करने में असमर्थ होने, सक्रिय होने या प्रयास करने की स्थिति से है।)\n\t
        \n\t\t

      \n\t
      • \n\t
    • Modesty refers to a humble or modest opinion or estimate of one's own abilities, qualities, or achievements. (विनय एक विनम्र या विनम्र राय या किसी की अपनी क्षमताओं, गुणों या उपलब्धियों का अनुमान है।)\n\t

      \n\t

    According to the meanings of the given words, the correct answer is Option 3, i.e., Modesty.

      \n\n
      Tom said to me, “please share some chocolates with me”.

      \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Tom asked me to share some chocolates with him."}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Tom requested me to shared some chocolates with him."}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Tom requested me to share some chocolates with him."}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Tom asked me to shared some chocolates with him."}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n
      The correct answer is option 3
      \n\n
       
      \n\n
      Key Points
      \n\n
        \n\t
      • \n\t
        In the second part “reported speech”, we can see the word ‘Please’ is mentioned, it shows that someone is requesting. It’s an imperative sentence.
        \n\t
        • \n\t
      • \n\t
        Now the reporting verb ‘said to’ will be changed into ‘requested’ and in the second part (reported speech) the requesting word ‘Please’ has to be removed.
        \n\t
        • \n\t
      • \n\t
        The preposition ‘to’ needs to be used to express the reason for the request and remember to remove the inverted commas.
        \n\t
        • \n\t
      • \n\t
        On the basis of reporting the subject,  the pronoun of reported speech will be changed. On the basis of ‘Tom’, the pronoun ‘me’ will be changed into ‘him’.
        \n\t
        • \n
      \n\n
      As we follow the above instructions, the final sentence will be ‘Tom requested me to share some chocolates with him.’
      \n\n
       
      \n\n
      Additional Information
      \n\n
       
      \n\n
        \n\t
      • \n\t
        The given sentence is in the form of “direct speech” which is mostly divided into two parts. The first part of the sentence is known as “Reporting Speech” & the other part as “Reported Speech”.
        \n\t
        • \n\t
      • \n\t
        If reported speech is an ‘Imperative sentence’, we need to understand the expression, whether it’s an order, request, proposal, and so on.
        \n\t
        • \n\t
      • \n\t
        The pattern would be - [Subject + verb + object + to-clause.]
        \n\t
        • \n\t
      • \n\t
        According to that, the changes have to be made, for example:-
        \n\n\t
          \n\t\t
        • My friend said to me,” stop smoking!”
          • \n\t\t
        • My friend suggested me to stop smoking.
          • \n\t
        \n\t
        • \n\t
      • A child said to me, “kindly buy me a candy”.
        • \n\t
      • A child requested me to buy him candy.
        • \n
      \n\n
       
      \n\n
      Hence, the final answer is "Tom requested me to share some chocolates with him".

          • \n\t
        \n\t
        • \n
      \n\n

      Thus, The correct sequence is:

      \n\n
        \n\t

        • \n\t

        • \n\t

        • \n\t
      • Q. Kaisar-i-Hind was Awarded to him, for raising an Indian Amnulace Core, in the year 1914.
        • \n\t
      • S6. He Arrived in India on 9 January 1915.
        • \n
      \n\n

      Correct Arrangement:  'S1RSPQS6'

      Directions: In this section, each item consists of six sentences of a passage. The first and sixth sentences are given in the beginning as S1 and S6. The middle four sentences in each have been jumbled up and labelled as P, Q, R and S. You are required to find the proper sequence of the four sentences and mark your response accordingly on the answer sheet.

      \n\n

      S1: Imitation is not civilization. 

      \n\n

      S6: When a man has begun to be ashamed of his ancestors, the end has come.  

      \n\n

      P: As ass in a lion's skin never makes a lion

      \n\n

      Q: It is verily the sign of awful degradation in a man.  

      \n\n

      R: Cowardly imitation never makes for progress. 

      \n\n

      S: When a man has begun to hate himself; then the last blow has come. 

      \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "PQRS"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "SPRQ&nbsp;"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "PRQS"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "QSRP&nbsp;"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

      The correct answer is "PRQS"

      \n\n

      Key Points

      \n\n
        \n\t
      • Sentence S1 states that imitation is not civilization.
        • \n\t
      • Sentence P compares a person who tries to imitate something they are not to an ass wearing a lion's skin, saying that it never makes a lion.
        • \n\t
      • Sentence R emphasizes that cowardly imitation never leads to progress.
        • \n\t
      • Sentence Q characterizes the act of imitation as a sign of degradation in a person.
        • \n\t
      • Sentence S states that when a person begins to hate themselves, it is a sign that the end has come.
        • \n\t
      • Sentence S6 adds that when a person begins to be ashamed of their ancestors, it is also a sign that the end has come.
        • \n\t
      • When the sentences are put in this order, they form a coherent and logical paragraph about the dangers of imitation and the importance of self-respect and pride in one's ancestors.
        • \n
      \n\n

      Thus, option 3 is the correct answer.

      \n\n

                Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

                Absorb

                \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "exude"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "imbibe"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "increase"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "reflect"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                The correct answer is "imbibe"

                \n\n

                Key Points

                \n\n
                  \n\t
                • Let's see the meanings of the given words-\n\t
                    \n\t\t
                  • 'Absorb' means to take in and hold something (a liquid, heat, etc.). (द्रव पदार्थ, ताप आदि को अपने में सोख लेना; अवशोषित करना)\n\n\t\t
                      \n\t\t\t
                    • Example: Plants absorb carbon in the form of carbon dioxide.
                      • \n\t\t
                    \n\t\t
                    • \n\t\t
                  • Imbibe- absorb or assimilate (ideas or knowledge). अवशोषित या आत्मसात (विचार या ज्ञान)।
                    • \n\t\t
                  • Exude- discharge or be discharged slowly and steadily. निर्वहन या धीरे-धीरे और लगातार निर्वहन किया जाना।
                    • \n\t\t
                  • Increase- become or make greater in size, amount, or degree. आकार, राशि, या डिग्री में अधिक से अधिक बनना या बनाना।
                    • \n\t\t
                  • Reflect- embody or represent (something) in a faithful or appropriate way एक वफादार या उचित तरीके से (कुछ) का प्रतीक या प्रतिनिधित्व करना
                    • \n\t
                  \n\t
                  • \n
                \n\n

                Hence, according to the meanings of the given words, the correct answer is Option 2 i.e. imbibe.

                The correct answer is 'She told him that she had been working on her project since morning.'

                \n\n

                Key Points

                \n\n
                  \n\t
                • While changing the narration of an assertive sentence, we need to follow the given steps-\n\n\t
                    \n\t\t
                  • The conjunction ‘that’ should be used in place of a comma (,) and inverted commas (“ ”).
                    • \n\t\t
                  • ‘Said to’ will be changed into ‘told’.
                    • \n\t\t
                  • When the reported speech is in the past perfect continuous tense it remains unchanged.
                    • \n\t\t
                  • The first person 'I' and 'my' are changed into 'she' and 'her' respectively i.e. according to the subject of the reporting speech (she).
                    \n\t\t 
                    • \n\t
                  \n\t
                  • \n
                \n\n

                Correct Sentence: She told him that she had been working on her project since morning.

                \n\n

                \n\n
                  \n\t
                •  एक assertive sentence का narration बदलते समय, हमें दिए गए steps का पालन करना होगा-\n\n\t
                    \n\t\t
                  • Comma (,) और inverted commas (" ") के स्थान पर conjunction 'that' का प्रयोग  किया जाना चाहिए।
                    • \n\t\t
                  • 'Said to' को 'told' में बदल दिया जाएगा।
                    • \n\t\t
                  • जब reported speech past perfect continuous tense में होता है तो वह अपरिवर्तित रहता है।
                    • \n\t\t
                  • First person 'I' और 'my’ क्रमशः 'she' और 'her' में बदल जाते हैं, यानी reporting speech के subject के अनुसार (she)।
                    • \n\t
                  \n\t
                  • \n

                Key Points

                \n\n
                  \n\t
                • The given sentence is an example of the future perfect tense.
                  • \n\t
                • In this tense whichever action is finished first, it will be written in the future perfect tense and to express another action simple present tense will be used.
                  • \n\t
                • Structure of future perfect tense:\n\t
                    \n\t\t
                  • Subject + will/shall + have + the third form of verb.\n\t\t

                \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "The chief economic advisor said that my subordinate had stepped down."}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "The chief economic advisor said that his subordinate has stepped down."}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "The chief economic advisor said that his subordinate stepped down."}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "The chief economic advisor said that his subordinate had stepped down."}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                The correct answer is 'The chief economic advisor said that his subordinate had stepped down.'

                \n\n

                Key Points

                \n\n
                  \n\t
                • The given question is in Direct Speech. As per the question we have to change it into Indirect Speech. 
                  • \n\t
                • The process of transformation is as follows:\n\t
                    \n\t\t
                  • 'said' will not change because the reporting verb does not have an object.
                    • \n\t\t
                  • Comma and inverted commas will be removed.
                    • \n\t\t
                  • The helping verb is changed according to the tense, followed by the 3rd form of the verb.
                    • \n\t\t
                  • The present perfect tense i.e. has stepped down will be changed to the past perfect tense i.e. had stepped down.
                    • \n\t\t
                  • The pronoun 'my' is replaced by 'his' because the first person pronoun is changed according to the subject of the reporting verb. 
                    • \n\t
                  \n\t
                  • \n\t
                • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 4.
                  \n\t​
                  • \n
                \n\n

                Correct Sentence: The chief economic advisor said that his subordinate had stepped down.

                      ", "hn": "", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Verbal Ability"], "concept": "Verbal Ability", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "69657663539045626f5becce", "qs_no": 1, "pos_marks": 3.0, "neg_marks": 1.0, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "Which of these is a secondary pollutant that is included in Air Quality Index (AQI) calculations?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "SO<sub>2</sub>"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "NO<sub>2</sub>"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "O<sub>3</sub>"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "PM<sub>10</sub>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "इनमें से कौन सा द्वितीयक प्रदूषक है जिसे वायु गुणवत्ता सूचकांक (एक्यूआई) गणना में शामिल किया जाता है", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "SO2"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "NO2"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "O3"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "PM10"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                      The correct answer is O3.

                      \n\n

                      Key Points

                      \n\n
                        \n\t
                      • Ozone (O3) is a secondary pollutant formed by the reaction of primary pollutants such as nitrogen oxides (NOx) and volatile organic compounds (VOCs) in the presence of sunlight.
                        • \n\t
                      • It is one of the key pollutants included in the Air Quality Index (AQI) calculations because of its significant impact on air quality and human health.
                        • \n\t
                      • O3 can cause respiratory problems, reduce lung function, and aggravate asthma and other lung diseases, making it a critical pollutant to monitor.
                        • \n\t
                      • The formation of ground-level ozone is heavily influenced by weather conditions and is typically higher during sunny and hot weather.
                        • \n\t
                      • In AQI standards, ozone is monitored as an 8-hour average, and its levels are categorized into different ranges to inform the public about air quality.
                        • \n
                      \n\n

                      Additional Information

                      \n\n
                        \n\t
                      • SO2 (Sulfur Dioxide):\n\t
                          \n\t\t
                        • SO2 is a primary pollutant released directly into the atmosphere from sources such as fossil fuel combustion and industrial processes.
                          • \n\t\t
                        • It contributes to acid rain formation and is harmful to human health, particularly the respiratory system.
                          • \n\t\t
                        • Although included in AQI, it is not classified as a secondary pollutant.
                          • \n\t
                        \n\t
                        • \n\t
                      • NO2 (Nitrogen Dioxide):\n\t
                          \n\t\t
                        • NO2 is a primary pollutant emitted from vehicles, industrial activities, and power generation.
                          • \n\t\t
                        • It is a precursor to secondary pollutants like ozone and particulate matter but is itself a primary pollutant.
                          • \n\t\t
                        • Exposure to NO2 can lead to respiratory issues and reduced lung function.
                          • \n\t
                        \n\t
                        • \n\t
                      • PM10 (Particulate Matter 10):\n\t
                          \n\t\t
                        • PM10 refers to particulate matter with a diameter of 10 micrometers or smaller, which can be inhaled and cause health problems.
                          • \n\t\t
                        • It is a primary pollutant generated from sources like construction activities, road dust, and combustion processes.
                          • \n\t\t
                        • PM10 is a significant component of AQI but is not a secondary pollutant.
                          • \n\t
                        \n\t
                        • \n
                      ", "hn": "\n

                      सही उत्तर O3 है।

                      \n\n

                      मुख्य बिंदु

                      \n\n
                        \n\t
                      • ओजोन (O3) एक द्वितीयक प्रदूषक है जो सूर्य के प्रकाश की उपस्थिति में नाइट्रोजन ऑक्साइड (NOx) और वाष्पशील कार्बनिक यौगिकों (VOCs) जैसे प्राथमिक प्रदूषकों की प्रतिक्रिया से बनता है।
                        • \n\t
                      • यह वायु गुणवत्ता और मानव स्वास्थ्य पर इसके महत्वपूर्ण प्रभाव के कारण वायु गुणवत्ता सूचकांक (AQI) गणनाओं में शामिल प्रमुख प्रदूषकों में से एक है।
                        • \n\t
                      • O3 श्वसन संबंधी समस्याएं पैदा कर सकता है, फेफड़ों के कार्य को कम कर सकता है, और अस्थमा और अन्य फेफड़ों की बीमारियों को बढ़ा सकता है, जिससे यह निगरानी के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रदूषक बन जाता है।
                        • \n\t
                      • भूतल ओजोन का निर्माण मौसम की स्थिति से बहुत प्रभावित होता है और आमतौर पर धूप और गर्म मौसम के दौरान अधिक होता है।
                        • \n\t
                      • AQI मानकों में, ओजोन को 8 घंटे के औसत के रूप में निगरानी की जाती है, और वायु गुणवत्ता के बारे में जनता को सूचित करने के लिए इसके स्तरों को विभिन्न श्रेणियों में वर्गीकृत किया जाता है।
                        • \n
                      \n\n

                      अतिरिक्त जानकारी

                      \n\n
                        \n\t
                      • SO2 (सल्फर डाइऑक्साइड):\n\t
                          \n\t\t
                        • SO2 एक प्राथमिक प्रदूषक है जो सीधे जीवाश्म ईंधन दहन और औद्योगिक प्रक्रियाओं जैसे स्रोतों से वातावरण में छोड़ा जाता है।
                          • \n\t\t
                        • यह अम्लीय वर्षा के निर्माण में योगदान देता है और मानव स्वास्थ्य, विशेष रूप से श्वसन प्रणाली के लिए हानिकारक है।
                          • \n\t\t
                        • AQI में शामिल होने के बावजूद, इसे द्वितीयक प्रदूषक के रूप में वर्गीकृत नहीं किया गया है।
                          • \n\t
                        \n\t
                        • \n\t
                      • NO2 (नाइट्रोजन डाइऑक्साइड):\n\t
                          \n\t\t
                        • NO2 वाहनों, औद्योगिक गतिविधियों और बिजली उत्पादन से उत्सर्जित होने वाला एक प्राथमिक प्रदूषक है।
                          • \n\t\t
                        • यह ओजोन और पार्टिकुलेट मैटर जैसे द्वितीयक प्रदूषकों का अग्रदूत है लेकिन स्वयं एक प्राथमिक प्रदूषक है।
                          • \n\t\t
                        • NO2 के संपर्क में आने से श्वसन संबंधी समस्याएं और फेफड़ों के कार्य में कमी हो सकती है।
                          • \n\t
                        \n\t
                        • \n\t
                      • PM10 (पार्टिकुलेट मैटर 10):\n\t
                          \n\t\t
                        • PM10 10 माइक्रोमीटर या उससे छोटे व्यास वाले पार्टिकुलेट मैटर को संदर्भित करता है, जिसे साँस में लिया जा सकता है और स्वास्थ्य समस्याएं हो सकती हैं।
                          • \n\t\t
                        • यह निर्माण गतिविधियों, सड़क धूल और दहन प्रक्रियाओं जैसे स्रोतों से उत्पन्न एक प्राथमिक प्रदूषक है।
                          • \n\t\t
                        • PM10 AQI का एक महत्वपूर्ण घटक है लेकिन द्वितीयक प्रदूषक नहीं है।
                          • \n\t
                        \n\t
                        • \n
                      \n179:T1007,\n

                      The correct answer is Hiring or engaging a child to commit an offence.

                      \n\n

                      Key Points

                      \n\n
                        \n\t
                      • Under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, hiring or engaging a child to commit an offence is considered a serious crime.
                        • \n\t
                      • This offence is punishable with a minimum imprisonment of 3 years, extendable up to 10 years, along with a fine.
                        • \n\t
                      • The law aims to deter individuals or groups from exploiting children for criminal activities, ensuring the protection of child rights.
                        • \n\t
                      • Such cases are triable by a Magistrate of the First Class, reflecting the gravity of the offence and the focus on speedy trial.
                        • \n\t
                      • The BNSS, 2023, is part of a broader initiative to reform and modernize criminal laws in India, with a focus on ensuring justice and safeguarding vulnerable groups, including children.
                        • \n
                      \n\n

                      Additional Information

                      \n\n
                        \n\t
                      • Kidnapping a minor\n\n\t
                          \n\t\t
                        • Kidnapping is defined under the Indian Penal Code (IPC), with kidnapping of minors being a particularly serious offence.
                          • \n\t\t
                        • It involves taking or enticing a minor (below 16 years for males and 18 years for females) out of the lawful custody of their guardian without consent.
                          • \n\t\t
                        • While punishable by imprisonment, the sentence may vary depending on the nature of the offence and intent.
                          • \n\t
                        \n\t
                        • \n\t
                      • Abandoning a child under 12 years\n\t
                          \n\t\t

                          The correct answer is Financial year from April to March.

                          \n\n

                          Key Points

                          \n\n
                            \n\t
                          • The Union Budget in India is prepared for the financial year (FY) starting from April 1 to March 31 of the subsequent year.
                            • \n\t
                          • This system aligns with the Indian government's accounting and taxation periods, ensuring better coordination with financial institutions and businesses.
                            • \n\t
                          • The budget is presented annually by the Union Finance Minister of India, typically on February 1, allowing adequate time for parliamentary approval and smooth implementation from April 1.
                            • \n\t
                          • The financial year format of April to March was adopted during the British colonial era and has continued since independence for consistency and ease of fiscal management.
                            • \n\t
                          • The financial year is also used for tax assessment purposes, with taxpayers filing returns for income earned during this period.
                            • \n
                          \n\n

                          Additional Information

                          \n\n
                            \n\t
                          • Calendar Year (Option 1):\n\n\t
                              \n\t\t
                            • The calendar year runs from January 1 to December 31.
                              • \n\t\t
                            • Many countries, organizations, and businesses use the calendar year for operational and reporting purposes.
                              • \n\t\t
                            • However, India does not follow the calendar year for its Union Budget or financial reporting, as it might disrupt alignment with tax and fiscal policies.
                              • \n\t
                            \n\t
                            • \n\t
                          • Fiscal Year from January to December (Option 2):\n\t
                              \n\t\t
                            • A fiscal year refers to the accounting year used by governments or corporations for reporting and budgeting purposes.
                              • \n\t\t
                            • Several countries, like the USA follow a fiscal year that does not align with the calendar year, but India has chosen April to March for its financial year.
                              • \n\t\t
                            • Adopting January to December would require significant restructuring of India’s taxation and financial systems.
                              • \n\t
                            \n\t
                            • \n\t
                          • Financial Year from July to June (Option 4):\n\t
                              \n\t\t
                            • This fiscal year system was used in India before 1867 during British rule, but was later changed to April to March.
                              • \n\t\t
                            • Countries like Pakistan and Egypt currently follow a July to June financial year.
                              • \n\t\t
                            • India does not follow this system as it may disrupt agricultural and other seasonal revenue cycles.
                              • \n\t
                            \n\t
                            • \n\t
                          • Main Theme:\n\t
                              \n\t\t
                            • The Union Budget is a comprehensive annual financial statement of the government’s revenue and expenditure for a specific financial year.
                              • \n\t\t
                            • It plays a crucial role in determining the government’s fiscal policies, tax structure, and development plans for the country.
                              • \n\t\t
                            • The timely presentation of the budget ensures smooth implementation of financial policies and programs in the country.
                              • \n\t
                            \n\t

                          सही उत्तर अप्रैल से मार्च तक वित्तीय वर्ष है।

                          \n\n

                          मुख्य बिंदु

                          \n\n
                            \n\t
                          • भारत में केंद्रीय बजट अगले वर्ष के 1 अप्रैल से 31 मार्च तक शुरू होने वाले वित्तीय वर्ष (एफवाई) के लिए तैयार किया जाता है।
                            • \n\t
                          • यह प्रणाली भारतीय सरकार की लेखांकन और कराधान अवधि के साथ संरेखित है, जो वित्तीय संस्थानों और व्यवसायों के साथ बेहतर समन्वय सुनिश्चित करती है।
                            • \n\t
                          • बजट वार्षिक रूप से भारत के केंद्रीय वित्त मंत्री द्वारा प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, आमतौर पर 1 फरवरी को, जिससे संसदीय अनुमोदन और 1 अप्रैल से सुचारू कार्यान्वयन के लिए पर्याप्त समय मिल सके।
                            • \n\t
                          • अप्रैल से मार्च तक के वित्तीय वर्ष के प्रारूप को ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक युग के दौरान अपनाया गया था और स्थिरता और राजकोषीय प्रबंधन में आसानी के लिए स्वतंत्रता के बाद से जारी है।
                            • \n\t
                          • वित्तीय वर्ष का उपयोग कर निर्धारण उद्देश्यों के लिए भी किया जाता है, जिसमें करदाता इस अवधि के दौरान अर्जित आय के लिए रिटर्न दाखिल करते हैं।
                            • \n
                          \n\n

                          अतिरिक्त जानकारी

                          \n\n
                            \n\t
                          • कैलेंडर वर्ष (विकल्प 1):\n\n\t
                              \n\t\t
                            • कैलेंडर वर्ष 1 जनवरी से 31 दिसंबर तक चलता है।
                              • \n\t\t
                            • कई देश, संगठन और व्यवसाय परिचालन और रिपोर्टिंग उद्देश्यों के लिए कैलेंडर वर्ष का उपयोग करते हैं।
                              • \n\t\t
                            • हालांकि, भारत अपने केंद्रीय बजट या वित्तीय रिपोर्टिंग के लिए कैलेंडर वर्ष का पालन नहीं करता है, क्योंकि इससे कर और राजकोषीय नीतियों के साथ संरेखण बाधित हो सकता है।
                              • \n\t
                            \n\t
                            • \n\t
                          • जनवरी से दिसंबर तक वित्तीय वर्ष (विकल्प 2):\n\t
                              \n\t\t
                            • एक वित्तीय वर्ष सरकारों या निगमों द्वारा रिपोर्टिंग और बजट उद्देश्यों के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले लेखा वर्ष को संदर्भित करता है।
                              • \n\t\t
                            • संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका जैसे कई देश एक वित्तीय वर्ष का पालन करते हैं जो कैलेंडर वर्ष के साथ संरेखित नहीं होता है, लेकिन भारत ने अपने वित्तीय वर्ष के लिए अप्रैल से मार्च को चुना है।
                              • \n\t\t
                            • जनवरी से दिसंबर तक अपनाने के लिए भारत की कराधान और वित्तीय प्रणालियों के महत्वपूर्ण पुनर्गठन की आवश्यकता होगी।
                              • \n\t
                            \n\t
                            • \n\t
                          • जुलाई से जून तक वित्तीय वर्ष (विकल्प 4):\n\t
                              \n\t\t
                            • इस वित्तीय वर्ष प्रणाली का उपयोग भारत में 1867 से पहले ब्रिटिश शासन के दौरान किया गया था, लेकिन बाद में इसे बदलकर अप्रैल से मार्च कर दिया गया।
                              • \n\t\t
                            • पाकिस्तान और मिस्र जैसे देश वर्तमान में जुलाई से जून तक वित्तीय वर्ष का पालन करते हैं।
                              • \n\t\t
                            • भारत इस प्रणाली का पालन नहीं करता है क्योंकि इससे कृषि और अन्य मौसमी राजस्व चक्र बाधित हो सकते हैं।
                              • \n\t
                            \n\t
                            • \n\t
                          • मुख्य विषय:\n\t
                              \n\t\t
                            • केंद्रीय बजट सरकार के राजस्व और व्यय का एक विशिष्ट वित्तीय वर्ष के लिए एक व्यापक वार्षिक वित्तीय विवरण है।
                              • \n\t\t
                            • यह देश के लिए सरकार की राजकोषीय नीतियों, कर संरचना और विकास योजनाओं को निर्धारित करने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है।
                              • \n\t\t
                            • बजट की समय पर प्रस्तुति देश में वित्तीय नीतियों और कार्यक्रमों के सुचारू कार्यान्वयन को सुनिश्चित करती है।
                              • \n\t

                          The correct answer is Rupees are not accepted in U.S. markets.

                          \n\n

                          Key Points

                          \n\n
                            \n\t
                          • Indian rupees are not accepted in the international market, including the U.S., due to their non-convertibility on a global scale.
                            • \n\t
                          • The U.S. dollar is a universally accepted and widely traded currency in international trade and serves as the global reserve currency.
                            • \n\t
                          • When Indian buyers purchase goods or services from the U.S., they must convert Indian rupees into U.S. dollars to complete the transaction.
                            • \n\t
                          • This conversion is facilitated through authorized dealers or financial institutions, such as banks, using the prevailing exchange rates.
                            • \n\t
                          • The process is essential for international trade and ensures smooth transactions between countries using different currencies.
                            • \n
                          \n\n

                          Additional Information

                          \n\n
                            \n\t
                          • To calculate shipping cost (Option 2):\n\n\t
                              \n\t\t
                            • Shipping costs are calculated based on factors such as weight, volume, destination, and mode of transport, but this has no direct link with currency conversion.
                              • \n\t\t
                            • The currency conversion is required for payment purposes, not for determining shipping costs.
                              • \n\t
                            \n\t
                            • \n\t
                          • To use foreign exchange for import payment (Option 3):\n\t
                              \n\t\t
                            • While foreign exchange is indeed used to make import payments, the need for currency conversion arises because foreign currencies like the U.S. dollar are required for such transactions.
                              • \n\t\t
                            • This option partially explains the process but does not directly address the reason for converting rupees to dollars.
                              • \n\t
                            \n\t
                            • \n\t
                          • To pay international taxes (Option 4):\n\t
                              \n\t\t
                            • Paying international taxes is not a primary reason for converting rupees to dollars when purchasing from the U.S.
                              • \n\t\t
                            • Taxes are generally added to the total cost of the product or service and are handled as part of the overall payment.
                              • \n\t
                            \n\t
                            • \n\t
                          • Understanding Currency Convertibility:\n\t
                              \n\t\t
                            • Currency convertibility refers to the ease with which a country's currency can be exchanged for another currency or gold.
                              • \n\t\t
                            • The Indian rupee is not fully convertible on the capital account, meaning it cannot be freely exchanged for foreign currencies for all types of transactions.
                              • \n\t\t
                            • Global trade relies on widely accepted currencies like the U.S. dollar, euro, or yen to facilitate transactions across borders.
                              • \n\t
